expectation.governedResultHashReason: styleTexture and stateMap are inside `target`, which the payload carries verbatim
expectation.note: All three elements are applicable and none loses precedence, so selection carries all three in every variant, including the one whose artefact renders none of them.

note: Section 14.3a: `selection` is applicability then precedence, and nothing after it. styleTexture and stateMap are projection policies: they decide what the artefact renders, not what the governance decision resolved to. Across every variant below the `selection` list MUST be identical, element for element and state for state. The governedResultHash still differs between variants, because both policies live inside `target` and `target` is in the payload verbatim: two plans asking for different projections are different governed requests. What must not happen is the projection changing which truth was resolved.
